children: (I-Vt.) warned that artificial intelligence could eventually become difficult for humans to control, while calling for the technology’s benefits to reach society broadly rather than primarily enriching billionaires.
On Saturday, Sanders made the remarks in an
post while sharing a clip from his appearance on Jimmy Kimmel Live.
"It is not complicated. Artificial intelligence must be used to benefit all of humanity, not make a handful of multi-billionaires even richer," he wrote in the post.
In the clip, Sanders said AI developers acknowledge that the technology is potentially dangerous and that its future remains uncertain.
"I have talked to some leading scientists in the world that tells us it’s only a question of time before AI becomes smarter than humans," he said.
He warned that if AI surpasses human intelligence and "humanity loses its ability to control AI," the consequences could be unpredictable.
"But if that happens and if humanity loses its ability to control AI, nobody knows what will happen," Sanders said. "I damn well do not want to wait around to see what will happen."
He also acknowledged AI’s potential benefits, particularly in health care.
